title: Kururin Pa!
overview:
Light the fuse and send the snowmen over all at once! Thrills, give-and-take, sudden comebacks. The more you play, the more fun it gets. Play with two and it gets even hotter. A cute new falling-block puzzle arrives.

The rules are simple. Skillfully connect the falling fuses and fire them all at once! For every one you burn, snowmen multiply on your opponent's field. Packed with fun, from comeback bomb attacks to a variety of attacks using special items. Versus mode is even hotter!! Anytime, anywhere, with anyone. Fun everyone can enjoy together.

導火線に火をつけて、一気に雪ダルマを送り込め!スリル、駆け引き、一発逆転。やればやるほど楽しめる。2人で遊べば、ますます熱い。キュートな落ちモノパズル新登場。

ルールは簡単。落ちてくる導火線を上手につないで一気にファイアー!燃やした数だけ、相手のフィールドに雪ダルマが増殖。一発逆転の爆弾攻撃やスペシャルアイテムを使った多彩な攻撃など楽しさ満載。対戦モードなら、さらに熱い!!いつでも、どこでも、誰とでも。みんなで遊べる楽しさです。
